title: Chapter 428
paragraphs: Chapter 428
124. Crisis of the Elders (2)
'What on earth is going on?'
'Without losing their minds...!'
The elders could barely hide their appalled hearts.
The bluish-purple swollen necks cluttered the long table.
As if the scene was too unsightly, Jin swept away the necks in front of him with a swish of his hand and placed the contract on the spot.

"I've made some copies just in case. It wouldn't be bad for everyone to read it once. It's a reference for the elders to know that if you want to kill me in the future, you'll have to pay at least this much to assassins on the level of the Ghost Squad."
Why?
Why is it so hard to scream at that crazy 12th-class guy...? It felt like a stone was blocking their throats, and the heavy atmosphere in the conference room felt suffocating.
On the other hand, Jin continued with a gentle smile.
"Ah, of course, I mean the minimum cost. If you're unlucky with only that much reward, this is what happens."
The conference room fell silent, amplifying even the sounds of breathing.
Jin calmly examined the faces of the elders, and the elders found it difficult to determine where to look.
They are undoubtedly the elders of Rune Kandel.

From a young age, they were classified as geniuses and became students of Rune Kandel. After becoming knights, they survived a long time, establishing numerous accomplishments. Finally, even in their old age, they held their place in the Garden of Swords.
Their stiffness was not due to the monstrous martial arts Jin had shown a while ago.
They had dealt with many martial artists and warriors with overwhelming martial prowess.
But there was definitely something else in Jin.
Something that cannot be explained by simply saying he had outstanding martial prowess or his courage surpassed imagination.
It was like looking at a wall.
A wall that could never be climbed or broken, no matter what they did.
For example, the elders saw the young days of Shiron in Jin.
However, just because Shiron seemed to appear at a glance, Jin was not the real Shiron.
It was also something they couldn't afford to do as Rune Kandel elders to shrink in fear.
"Have you ever seen such a crazy guy! The 12th class, do you know what you've done? How dare you show such nonsense here!"
"I can't find even a speck of respect for the family elders. The dead elders tried to kill you? You brought such a trivial piece of paper as evidence. Killing as many as ten elders...!"
"This is an insult to the Elder Council, what you've done is treason against the family!"
As the dam burst, the elders who had risen to their feet shouted in anger. Their faces twisted with rage seemed ready to chew Jin up and swallow him at any moment.
Despite the killing intent emitted by the elders, Jin's entire body tingled. However, that level of energy was nothing more than a trivial matter to Jin now.
"Respect, insult, rebellion."
A snicker escaped from between his lips.
He wasn't forcing himself to laugh just to anger the elders further.
Sincerely, Jin found the elders' words ridiculous.
He felt nauseous that he and those old, decaying people shared the name "Runecandel."
"You're laughing? You've lost your mind...!"
"You outdated, rotten ghosts! Do you truly not know shame?"
The elders could only blink their widened eyes once more.
It felt like being hit in the head with a heavy club.
"You want me to respect you all? Did you say not to insult Runecandel?"
This time, Jin's expression contorted in anger.
His eyes were filled with vivid, intense murderous intent, but his smiling mouth gave him a demonic appearance.

"It is you who insult Runecandel, this shining name of struggle! It's disgusting to the point of madness that I share the same name with you, who just sit in the position of old age, swallowing rotten power."
"12th generation!"
"Shut up, before I put your neck on the table with the others. You all need to listen carefully to what I have to say from now on."
Although the elders looked ready to draw their swords at any moment, Lynn Milkano, the President of the Magic Court, raised her hand to stop them.
Managing to maintain some composure, Lynn's hand was trembling slightly.
A tremor caused by a mix of rage and shivering.
She was one of the people who had witnessed Jin's prowess during his "Head of the Family Declaration."
"Don't forget the essence. The reason I killed the elders and humiliated them is that they lost to me in a fight. If that angers you, then you should try to break and trample me. In any way!"
Hierarchy war.
Jin accepted the fight between him and the elders as such.
A fight not between generations but as Runecandel against Runecandel.
Once again, silence flowed, and Jin's rough breathing grew more intense.
As the blood vessels in his eyes subsided, his breathing steadied, and Jin returned to his usual indifferent expression.
"Please... From now on. I hope you'll be worthy of standing against me in battle, esteemed elders."
With those words, Jin finished speaking and left the meeting room without waiting for the elders' response.
As the elders stared at the spot where Jin had disappeared, they all shared the same emotions.
A sense of defeat, humiliation, and anger.

"Sigh, after the last disturbance, the head elder said that the 12th generation has a lot to do for the family for the time being... But this is going too far. We need an urgent plan. We cannot let this continue."

"The 12th generation is utterly insane! First, we need to prepare for the funeral of the deceased elders, and then inform the head elder and the acting head of the family about this matter. Severe punishment is necessary..."
Trot, trot!
Suddenly, the sound of footsteps echoed in the hallway.
It was the sound of Black Panther Rosa Runecandel's footsteps.
"There's no need for the elders to inform me separately. I've already heard and seen everything."
As Rosa entered the meeting room, the elders stood up and bowed their heads.
Her face was expressionless, but the elders didn't miss the dangerous atmosphere emanating from her.
'Did the acting head of the family not take any action after undoubtedly encountering the 12th generation just now?'
'The acting head of the family and the 12th generation are definitely not in collusion... This doesn't feel good.'
As the elders suspected, Jin had encountered Rosa on his way in but had not exchanged a single word or glance with her.
It was like a fierce beast avoiding a fight at an unfavorable time.
Rosa looked down at the necks on the table.
Soon, a sun-like, bright white aura formed in her hand, and without any hesitation, she used the aura to eliminate the corpses of the dead elders.
There was no blood, no flesh and bones, nor brain matter scattered.
The corpses had been cleanly vaporized by the heat emanating from her hand.
At that sight, the elders couldn't help but be startled again.
'Surely the acting head of the family hasn't recovered from her injuries yet, but what is this level of skill?'
'She must have gained new enlightenment... Otherwise... It's like watching the head of the family's sword.'
The realm of completely annihilating objects.
What Rosa had just demonstrated was similar to that realm, but it couldn't be called the same.
Rosa herself felt this fact most painfully.
'After taking the blow from my youngest that day... It's been a long time since I've gained new enlightenment. However, the realm you've reached is still impossibly far, head of the family.'
After being critically injured by Jin's sword, Rosa was able to break through a layer of the wall.
Regardless of the power, Jin's sword that day had shocked her more than any other sword she had encountered.
Today, she showed the results to the elders for the first time.
"Congratulations, acting head of the family! You've reached a new realm."
"Amidst the chaos of the family, such a fortunate event... You haven't fully recovered yet, but this is incredible power."
As soon as the elders began to offer congratulations, Rosa's eyes grew cold.
The elders could only feel their entire bodies freezing under her icy gaze.
"What did you want to accomplish by informing me of the 12th generation's actions, elders?"
At her words, the smiling expressions of the congratulating elders instantly hardened.
"Did you want me to punish the 12th generation on behalf of the council of elders?"
"Acting head of the family, that's not..."
"Or did you want me to act as a shield to prevent the 12th generation from harming the council of elders any further?"
At a loss for words.
They couldn't deny it. As if unable to bear the shame, the wrinkled faces of the elders turned red.
"Head of the Law Enforcement, you may answer."
When Rosa pointed at him, Lin took a deep breath.
"The acting head of the family is not wrong in any way, and this old man can only feel shame."
"From today on,"
Rosa said, looking at the elders.

"The council of elders must reestablish its raison d'etre and prove its worth. If you disappoint me one more time, I will temporarily close the council of elders until the head of the family returns."
"No, acting head of the family! What do you mean?"
"Temporarily closing the council of elders, that's too much."
Don't be absurd.
The elder about to say that couldn't finish his sentence.
Swoosh-! The sword energy that suddenly emanated from Rosa's palm had split him in half.
Hiss...
Instead of blood, white particles dyed with her aura flowed from the cut surface and stained the air.
Eventually, when the flowing particles stopped, the dead elder's body had taken on a strange form, as if it had been burnt.
"I trust there will be no more of those who believe the time they have received for free gives them the strength to defy my words."
As Lin Milcano knelt on one knee, the remaining elders lowered their bodies in unison following him.
Rosa looked down at them and said:
"Whether you fight tenaciously or live like a parasite depends on your choice. Depending on that, I can be infinitely merciful or cruel to the elders and their offspring. Keep that in mind."
At Rosa's final words, the elders' faces turned pale.
